title: Cyber — Network Security Coverage, Endorsement 7 (Policy A)

clauses.heading: Insuring Agreement A
clauses.text: We will pay Loss resulting from a Network Security Event first discovered during the Policy Period.

clauses.heading: Exclusion 4(f)
clauses.text: This Policy does not apply to Loss arising out of the Insured's failure to maintain the Minimum Security Standards.

clauses.heading: Endorsement 7
clauses.text: Exclusion 4(f) shall not apply to Loss resulting from a Network Security Event, provided the Insured complied with the notice obligations in Section 9.

clauses.heading: Definitions — Minimum Security Standards
clauses.text: "Minimum Security Standards" means the controls listed in Schedule B, maintained continuously.

witness_scenario: Example: a ransomware event first discovered in March, where a Schedule B control had lapsed — excluded under 4(f) — but the Insured gave timely notice under Section 9. Endorsement 7 restores coverage and the claim pays.
plain_english_why: Endorsement 7's condition — timely notice under Section 9 — is independent of what Exclusion 4(f) excludes. A claim can be excluded for a security-standards failure and still satisfy the notice condition, so there are real claim scenarios in which the carveback gives coverage back. The endorsement does the work it advertises.
